title: How Wonderful
description: Introduces a fermentation system with a barrel to brew beers capable of storing combined potion effects. Additionally, it adds functional plates to display and consume food stacks directly in the environment through the use of a fork.
body:
# HOW WONDERFUL MOD
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c66a6ec3bf313a62eff0bbf716001f2fcbacfd12_0.webp)
### Beer Barrel
> Function: Beverage preparation and fermentation station.
>  
> Required Ingredients: 1 sugar, leaves from any type of tree, 1 hay bale, 1 Nether wart, and 4 water buckets.
>   
> How to use: After placing the materials into the container, you must right-click while crouching on the barrel to start the fermentation process.
>    
> Time and Yield: The maturation cycle requires a total of 5 full in-game days. Once the time is up, the barrel will grant a total of 20 uses before being completely emptied.

### Refillable Beer
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b5fb85e66f18d46b81ce6b753fb4fb1bc1034bb_0.webp)
> Function: Dynamic beverage container that absorbs and stores status effects.
> 
> Infusion System: To transfer a potion's properties to the beer, the potion must be placed in the off-hand, the beer in the main hand, and you must right-click while crouching.
> 
> Refill Mechanic: The container can be refilled by directly interacting with the Beer Barrel once it has finished fermenting.
> 
> Restriction: When refilling the beer in the barrel, any previously infused potion effect will be permanently lost, clearing the container for a new use.

### Plate
> Function: Display, storage, and food consumption block in the world.
> 
> Capacity: Supports placing a full stack (up to 64 units) of the same type of item or block on its surface.
> 
> Interaction: Serves as a physical support to consume food directly from the environment, visually displaying the remaining amount of food.
> 
> Hidden Mechanics: Features additional secret functionalities that interact with game systems, designed to be discovered by players through experimentation.

### Fork
> Function: Specialized tool or utensil for food consumption.
> 
> How to use: By right-clicking 3 consecutive times on a plate containing food, the player will directly and quickly consume a full portion of the food without needing to hold the food item in their hand.
